from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
__metaclass__ = type

from units.compat.mock import patch
from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
from .icx_module import TestICXModule


class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
    module = icx_logging

    def setUp(self):
        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
        self.get_config_patch = patch.object(icx_logging, 'get_config')
        self.get_config = self.get_config_patch.start()
        self.load_config_patch = patch.object(icx_logging, 'load_config')
        self.load_config = self.load_config_patch.start()
        self.get_config.return_value = ''

    def tearDown(self):
        self.get_config_patch.stop()
        self.load_config_patch.stop()
        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()

    def test_aggregate_ipv6_host_and_facility(self):
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=5514,
                                             facility='local7'),
                                        dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging facility local7',
                                                     'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514',
                                                     'logging host 192.0.2.1'])

    def test_host_removal_discovers_port_and_is_idempotent(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514'
        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514'])
        self.get_config.return_value = ''
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_existing_ipv6_host_and_facility(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = ('logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514\\n'
                                        'logging facility local7')
        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=5514,
                             facility='local7'))
        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

    def test_facility_and_global_clearing(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = 'logging facility local7\\nlogging console'
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(facility='local7', state='absent'),
                                        dict(dest='console', state='absent'),
                                        dict(dest='on', state='absent')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging facility', 'no logging console',
                                                     'no logging on'])

    def test_buffered_levels_and_rfc5424(self):
        self.get_config.return_value = ('logging buffered\\nno logging buffered debugging\\n'
                                        'logging enable rfc5424')
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'),
                                        dict(dest='buffered', level='errors', state='absent'),
                                        dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent')]))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging buffered debugging',
                                                     'no logging buffered errors',
                                                     'no logging enable rfc5424'])

    def test_required_fields(self):
        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered'))
        self.execute_module(failed=True)
        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='host')]))
        self.execute_module(failed=True)

    def test_check_mode(self):
        set_module_args(dict(dest='console', _ansible_check_mode=True))
        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging console'])
        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
